title: Barcelona e-bike tour
text: Great way to see Barcelona on the first day! Our guide, Lily was very helpful and knowledgeable. We covered a lot of sites and learned about the city.
author: Sally_A

title: A perfect taste of Barcelona!
text: Our tour with Lili was absolutely fantastic! The tour was so comprehensive and we really got a great sense of Barcelona. Lili is so knowledgeable and just plain cool. I would do it again!
author: Explore22046488242

title: Great day seeing Barcelona!
text: Our guide Lili was exceptional in showing us the history and highlights of Barcelona.  She was very knowledgeable on Barcelona in its past and current times.  We were lucky enough to he the only two on the tour and had a wonderful, fun experience.   I would highly recommend this tour.  It definitely takes the length of time promised and also a pretty good workout, even with the Ebikes.  Super fun day!
author: Debra_T

title: Fun in Barcelona
text: Great way to see Barcelona!   Especially if you have limited time.    Touched on all the highlights and traveling by bike was a blast.   Tour guide knowledgeable and friendly.
author: John_C

title: A must do in Barcelona !
text: Lili was patient,  kind and filled with loads of information that she shared on this hands down best tour of Barcelona!  The history she shared on our stops made the trip that  more interesting on top of the joy of the actual biking.   Would highly recommend this to your itinerary.
author: Voyager41535608885

title: Perfect way to see Barcelona!
text: We booked this bike tour for the day after we arrived in Barcelona from the US and it was perfect! Sunday mornings are slower in town (highly recommend this time) and Agatha was so patient and helpful with any questions that we had about anything. The e-bikes were easy and fun to use and this event was enjoyed by all of us (56,52,20,18,17). Highly recommend this!
author: Kristen_V

title: We were only going to be...
text: We were only going to be in Barcelona for a short period and this bike tour gave us a great overview of the city and highlight areas we wanted to see plus a few more.  Our guide, Agatha, was amazing and appreciated her knowledge of the city. She was easy to understand and worked well with the entire group.  Working with Viator was easy and appreciated their reach outs/reminders on our upcoming e-bike tour.
author: Jacqueline_S

title: E bike tour
text: Great experience and got to see the whole city and Agatha was the best!
author: benvI1215WO

title: Great ride!!
text: Our tour guide, Monica, was fun & very knowledgeable. Made the ride feel effortless while pointing out everything we needed to know about Barcelona.
author: damira234

title: Best bike tour in Barcelona!
text: This tour was the best and Agatha was the best guide. She knew so much about the city. It was super fun. I would book again.
author: ashleycM3348XV
